Breadth of rotation is tight (0.18) and rotation is non-directional (absorption 0.46), so this is a quality/income-led tape, not a broad or speculative one. Gate_helps is true here, so trend discipline has historically cut drawdown in this market — a reason to keep focus on eligible, high-durability themes only.
emerging_watch: Watching China Tech & Internet (3033.HK, mean-revert tag) for a confirmed leadership handoff from the income-heavy tape: if its score rises into positive territory AND it enters the eligible set with breadth above 0.4 before the next note, the defensive regime read would need updating. Until then the watch stays open on the current narrow-eligible structure.
